belief: Any trigonometric ratio can be used interchangeably.
correct_model: Ratio selection depends on the chosen angle and sides.

belief: Action-reaction forces act on the same object.
correct_model: They act on two different interacting bodies.

belief: Constant velocity requires a non-zero net force.
correct_model: Constant velocity means zero acceleration and zero net force.

belief: Vector components are always positive magnitudes.
correct_model: Components are signed projections along chosen axes.
